CURRENT QUESTION:
where did attendance percentage decline the most year on year - average the monthly rates per centre and show the decline in percentage points as a positive figure
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH combined_data AS (
  SELECT
    "Centre" AS centre_name,
    "Month" AS month,
    "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolment,
    "Avg Daily Present" AS attendance
  FROM "attendance_2023"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "centre_name",
    "month",
    "enrolment",
    "average_attendance"
  FROM "attendance_2024"
),
monthly_rates AS (
  SELECT
    centre_name,
    month,
    CASE 
      WHEN month IN ('January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December') 
      THEN (CAST(attendance AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(enrolment, 0)) * 100 
    END AS rate,
    CASE 
      WHEN month IN ('January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December') 
      THEN 2023 ELSE 2024 
    END AS year
  FROM combined_data
),
yearly_averages AS (
  SELECT
    centre_name,
    year,
    AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM monthly_rates
  GROUP BY centre_name, year
),
comparisons AS (
  SELECT
    a23.centre_name,
    (a23.avg_rate - a24.avg_rate) AS decline_pp
  FROM yearly_averages a23
  JOIN yearly_averages a24 ON a23.centre_name = a24.centre_name
  WHERE a23.year = 2023 AND a24.year = 2024
)
SELECT
  centre_name
FROM comparisons
ORDER BY decline_pp DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
